sources.title: Berks County Summary Results Report, 2026 General Primary, Official Results (report dated 06/05/2026)
Berks County Election Services: Election Results index

notes: Seats are the Republican county committee contests printed in the county's official 2026 primary summary report: every one of the 202 precincts has a Committeeman and a Committeewoman contest, and 128 precincts also have a 'County Committeeperson' contest (113 vote-for-1, 14 vote-for-2, 1 vote-for-3), so seats per precinct range from 2 to 5; the party rule behind the extra Committeeperson seats was not located and the count follows the ballot. Status rules: a filed candidate with votes = filled (marked unknown if the write-in total exceeded that candidate or a tie decided the last seat); no filed candidate and zero write-in votes = empty; no filed candidate but write-in votes cast = unknown. In 2 of the contests with no filed candidate the report credits write-in votes to a named person; those seats remain unknown because acceptance of write-in winners was not verified. Appointments after the primary are not reflected.
